subject: [PATCH 20/60] mm/ksm: restrict merging to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original patch author posted the same message twice in a row, which is unusual. The content of the message appears to be a standard patch submission with no technical discussion or questions.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts the merging of memory in KSM (Kernel Samepage Merging) to common memory only, excluding ZONE_DEVICE folios and anonymous pages outside the ordinary memory pool.
